alt: Pass rate against completion tokens in log-spaced bins, one line per typical threshold plus the release arm, with a task-count table under the axis and a cap-hit column
caption: _Pass rate against how long the completion ran, per typical threshold. Every bin is joined and the y-range comes from the data, so no point falls off the axis and breaks a line. Series carry a small constant downward offset so lines that share a value can be told apart; the offset never changes the values or the counts. Cap hits are off the axis, with their counts in the right-hand column. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._
label: HumanEval pass rate by completion length

alt: Grouped bars of pass rate against per-request decode speed in fixed log-spaced tok/s bins, one bar per typical threshold plus the release arm, each labelled failed over total
caption: _Pass rate against per-request decode speed, in fixed log-spaced bins, as grouped bars: several series share the same rate, which lines draw on top of each other. Each bar is labelled failed/total. The eval ran 4 concurrent requests, so this speed is relative to that concurrency, not the single-stream 16K figure. Cap hits are excluded from the bins, with their counts in the right-hand column. Scored from the re-scored HumanEval rows._
label: HumanEval pass rate by per-request decode speed

alt: Decode tok/s for the twelve interleaved 16K windows in run order plus the typical sweep's own windows past a separator, fastest seed as the point with a min-max band, one colour per arm or threshold
caption: _The twelve interleaved 16K windows (A C D E x three rounds) in run order, then the typical sweep's own windows past the dotted separator. Each point is the window's fastest seed; the band is min-max over its three seeds. The dashed line is each arm's fastest window. A drift (first vs last) = +0.17 tok/s (+0.24%)._
label: 16K ABAB decode by window

alt: Decode tok/s against HumanEval pass@1, one labelled point per typical threshold plus the release arm, filled marker strict and hollow marker completed-task pass@1, horizontal band the pooled min-max decode
caption: _Decode rate against task quality, one point per operating point. The filled marker is strict pass@1, the hollow marker the completed-task value at the same decode rate; the horizontal band is the pooled min-max over that point's windows, with n in the label. Quality is one seed at the cell's own sampler._
label: decode tok/s against HumanEval pass@1
